exposure: Complete hydatidiform mole and coexisting fetus (CHMCF)
outcome: Elevated maternal serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (BhCG) level
cohort: A 41-year-old woman with a twin pregnancy diagnosed with a complete hydatidiform mole and a coexisting fetus.
finding: This case report details an unexpected diagnosis of complete hydatidiform mole and coexisting fetus (CHMCF) with pulmonary metastasis, emphasizing the importance of meticulous pathological examination.
mod_finding: The woman delivered a female baby by cesarean section at 28 + 5 weeks of gestation, but no specific findings related to the mode of birth are reported beyond its occurrence.
